bred_seeds_status_valid.name: bred_seeds_status_valid
bred_seeds_status_valid.value: ("bred_seeds"."status" = 'available' AND "bred_seeds"."planted_at" IS NULL AND "bred_seeds"."planted_specimen_id" IS NULL) OR ("bred_seeds"."status" = 'planted' AND "bred_seeds"."planted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "bred_seeds"."planted_specimen_id" IS NOT NULL)

gameplay_command_receipts_completed_shap.name: gameplay_command_receipts_completed_shape
gameplay_command_receipts_completed_shap.value: "gameplay_command_receipts"."status" <> 'completed' OR ("gameplay_command_receipts"."response_payload" IS NOT NULL AND "gameplay_command_receipts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

genetic_profiles_ratings_bounded.name: genetic_profiles_ratings_bounded
genetic_profiles_ratings_bounded.value: "genetic_profiles"."vigor" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "genetic_profiles"."growth_speed" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "genetic_profiles"."size" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "genetic_profiles"."flowering" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "genetic_profiles"."mutation_chance" BETWEEN 0 AND 100

plant_specimens_lifecycle_valid.name: plant_specimens_lifecycle_valid
plant_specimens_lifecycle_valid.value: ("plant_specimens"."lifecycle_status" = 'growing' AND "plant_specimens"."collected_at" IS NULL) OR ("plant_specimens"."lifecycle_status" IN ('owned','sold') AND "plant_specimens"."collected_at" IS NOT NULL)

mail_messages_pending_specimen_unique.name: mail_messages_pending_specimen_unique
mail_messages_pending_specimen_unique.where: "mail_messages"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "mail_messages"."specimen_id" IS NOT NULL

mail_messages_text_bounded.name: mail_messages_text_bounded
mail_messages_text_bounded.value: length("mail_messages"."subject") BETWEEN 1 AND 80 AND length("mail_messages"."text") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

mail_messages_claim_valid.name: mail_messages_claim_valid
mail_messages_claim_valid.value: "mail_messages"."claimed_at" IS NULL OR "mail_messages"."attachment" IS NOT NULL

wild_genetic_seeds_status_valid.name: wild_genetic_seeds_status_valid
wild_genetic_seeds_status_valid.value: ("wild_genetic_seeds"."status" = 'available' AND "wild_genetic_seeds"."planted_at" IS NULL AND "wild_genetic_seeds"."planted_specimen_id" IS NULL) OR ("wild_genetic_seeds"."status" = 'planted' AND "wild_genetic_seeds"."planted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "wild_genetic_seeds"."planted_specimen_id" IS NOT NULL)
